positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Internal Tools Team
- Utilized Python, Flask, Jinja2, and Javascript to create a comprehensive dashboard, which enabled onsite engineers to monitor test results and device performance over time.
- Implemented customized notification system using Python and Celery for streamlined management of alerts and providing important insights to assist the users with better decision making.
- Reduced dashboard loading time from 13 seconds to 0.2 second by leveraging SQLalchemy and asynchronous data loading to streamline data queries and reduce response times.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · JavaScript · MySQL · Flask · SQLAlchemy
